items.title: Steve Buckingham, interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 25, 2019 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: It was at Rick’s studio, although Jerry Wexler produced it.

ctx.x: Did the studios or the record companies ever try to lock some of these people in? Like, “We just want you to work for us.”

Oh yeah. But not in LA. In Muscle Shoals there was a great producer, Rick Hall, who died a year or two ago. And Rick had his studio. It’s still there. His grandson runs it I think. FAME. Florence, Alabama Music Enterprises. And Rick, that’s where Aretha went to cut the first hits on Atlantic. She was on Columbia and never had a hit but she got to Atlantic and bam, “I Never Loved a Man the Way I Love You.” It was at Rick’s studio, although Jerry Wexler produced it. Tom Dowd engineered it, came down from New York.…
